newsitem.title: RUSSIA: No news on board meeting until next week - Norilsk.
newsitem.headline: No news on board meeting until next week - Norilsk.

text.p: Russia's giant metals group Norilsk Nickel NKEL.RTS said on Friday it would not have any details on Thursday's board meeting or a meeting of shareholders of the group's flagship metals combine until next week.
"We won't be saying anything on the meetings today," said the group's Moscow-based spokesman Anatoly Komrakov.
"There may be a release on the results of the meetings on Monday," he added.
Komrakov said earlier this week that the company's debts and the prospect of issuing securities were likely to be on the agenda at the meetings.
He confirmed that RAO Norilsky Nikel was working towards an American Depositary Receipt (ADR) issue by July, in line with announcements made by the company last month.
Norilsk shares rose sharply on the Russian Trading System on Friday on what traders said were expectations of an ADR issue by Norilsk.
Shares were up to $7.10 at 1040 GMT from $6.35 at the close on Thursday - a rise of 12 percent.
Komrakov said the ADR issue was not discussed at the board of directors meeting on Thursday.
